terms.noticeBody: EventHub is a marketplace platform — we connect customers with independent vendors. We are not a party to any transaction between customers and vendors. All bookings, services, and disputes are between the customer and the vendor directly.
terms.s1Body: By accessing or using EventHub, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.
terms.s2Body: EventHub is a platform that connects customers with independent vendors. We are not a party to any transaction, do not employ vendors, and do not guarantee the quality or legality of any service listed.
terms.s3Body: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activity under your account.
terms.s4Body: Vendors are solely responsible for the accuracy of their listings, including pricing, availability, and service descriptions. EventHub does not verify listing content.
terms.s5Body: All bookings are subject to vendor acceptance. Payments are processed through Stripe. EventHub does not charge platform or service fees on bookings; vendors receive their full payout, less standard payment processing fees.
terms.s6Body: Cancellation policies are set by individual vendors and are displayed on each listing. EventHub enforces the vendor's stated policy. Refunds are issued per that policy.
terms.s7Body: Customers have a 72-hour dispute window after the event date to report issues. Disputes are handled between the customer and vendor. EventHub may assist in resolution but is not obligated to do so.
terms.s8Body: Users may not use EventHub to conduct transactions outside the platform, share contact information for the purpose of circumventing the platform, post false or misleading listings, or engage in harassment or discrimination.
terms.s9Body: All content on EventHub, including logos, design, and code, is owned by EventHub or its licensors. You may not copy, reproduce, or distribute any content without written permission.
terms.s10Body: EventHub is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of the platform, including but not limited to vendor no-shows, property damage, or personal injury.
terms.s11Body: You agree to indemnify and hold harmless EventHub and its affiliates from any claims, damages, or expenses arising from your use of the platform or violation of these Terms.
terms.s12Body: EventHub reserves the right to update these Terms at any time. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.
terms.s13Body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Florida, without regard to conflict of law principles.
terms.s14Body: For questions about these Terms, contact us at legal@eventhub.com.
